if Shop1EnhanceManager == nil then
    Shop1EnhanceManager = class({})
end

Shop1EnhanceManager.states = Shop1EnhanceManager.states or {}
Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered = Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered or false
Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index = Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index or {}

Shop1EnhanceManager.config = Shop1EnhanceManager.config or {
    choice_count = 3,
    shop_item_id = 2,
}

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
    local weight = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Weight or 1) or 1
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    if weight > 1000 then
        weight = 1000
    end
    return weight
end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local total = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level, #tokens)]
    end

    return s
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayText(raw, level)
    local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if token == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return tostring(token)
end

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end

    if type(raw) == "number" then
        if base_value ~= nil then
            return base_value + raw
        end
        return raw
    end

    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if token ~= nil then
            local percent = ParsePercentValue(token)
            if percent ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                if base_value ~= nil then
                    local base = tonumber(base_value)
                    if base == nil then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return base + numeric
                end
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local percent = ParsePercentValue(resolved)
    if percent ~= nil then
        local base = tonumber(base_value)
        if base == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return base * (1 + percent / 100)
    end

    if type(resolved) == "string" then
        local numeric = tonumber(resolved)
        if numeric ~= nil then
            if base_value ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base + numeric
            end
            return numeric
        end
    end

    return resolved
end

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            table.insert(list, trimmed)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function NormalizeList(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return {}
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            table.insert(list, k)
            if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                table.insert(list, v)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return {}
    end

    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
    if #pipe > 0 then
        return pipe
    end

    return { raw }
end

local function NormalizePanoramaImagePath(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return ""
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return ""
    end

    s = string.gsub(s, "%.vtex_c$", ".vtex")
    s = string.gsub(s, "^s2r://panorama/images/", "s2r://panorama/images//")

    local prefix = "panorama/images/"
    if string.sub(s, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return "s2r://panorama/images//" .. string.sub(s, #prefix + 1)
    end

    if string.sub(s, 1, #"s2r://") == "s2r://" then
        return s
    end

    return "s2r://" .. s
end

local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
    return list[idx]
end

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)
    if not kv or not key then
        return nil
    end
    local raw = kv[key]
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local tokens = ParseStringArray(tostring(raw))
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level or 1, #tokens)]
    end
    return raw
end

local function GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, key, level, overrides)
    if overrides and overrides[key] ~= nil then
        return tonumber(overrides[key])
    end
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end
    local raw
    if item_kv.AbilityValues and item_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv.AbilityValues, key, level)
    else
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(raw)
end

local function SetOverride(overrides, key, raw, level)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, key, raw, level, base_value)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return nil
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return nil
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
    return resolved
end

local function ResolveSourceKey(name, hero_name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack") and hero_name and hero_name ~= "" then
        return hero_name .. "_" .. name
    end
    return name
end

local function ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, raw_item_name)
    if not cfg or not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end
    local raw = cfg.ItemSource
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return false
    end
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return false
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(list) do
        if tostring(item) == tostring(raw_item_name) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return slots
    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)
    if base and base ~= "" and base ~= "none" then
        table.insert(slots, { name = base, context = "Projectile" })
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then
            -- stop scanning once we are past the default slots and no explicit key exists
            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))
    end
    push("AbilitySP")
    push("ModifierSP")

    return list
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end
    local targets = NormalizeList(cfg.Projectile)
    if #targets == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do
        if tostring(name) == tostring(projectile_name) then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        local resolved = SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)

        print("[Shop1Enhance] override", prefix, tostring(projectile_name), tostring(raw),
            "base", tostring(base_value), "result", tostring(resolved))
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_number("ProjectileDamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)
        local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number(prefix .. "BaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_number(prefix .. "DamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value(prefix .. "PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if IsEmptyValue(val) then
            return key
        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"
end

local function ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, level, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg or not item_kv then
        return
    end

    local additional_list = NormalizeList(cfg.AdditionalProjectile)
    for i, name in ipairs(additional_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key, slot_idx = GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            local suffix = (slot_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(slot_idx)

            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, i),
                level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Interval",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Range",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "BaseDamage",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "DamageScale",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileDamageScale, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "PurePercent",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalPurePercent, i), level)
        end
    end

    local passive_list = NormalizeList(cfg.Passive)
    for i, name in ipairs(passive_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key = GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.PassiveLevel, i), level)
        end
    end

    local ability_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.AbilitySP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(ability_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "AbilitySP", ability_sp, level)
    end

    local modifier_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.ModifierSP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(modifier_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "ModifierSP", modifier_sp, level)
    end

    SetOverride(overrides, "LifestealSP", GetListValueAt(cfg.LifestealSP, 1), level)
end

local function BuildEffectList(cfg, level, prefix)
    if not cfg then
        return {}
    end
    local name_key = prefix .. "Name"
    local names = NormalizeList(cfg[name_key])
    if #names == 0 then
        return {}
    end

    local list = {}
    for i, raw_name in ipairs(names) do
        local name = tostring(raw_name or "")
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            table.insert(list, {
                name = name,
                interval = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "Interval"], i), level),
                range = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "Range"], i), level),
                base_damage = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "BaseDamage"], i), level),
                damage_scale = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "DamageScale"], i), level),
                heal_percent = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "HealPercent"], i), level),
                pure_percent = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "PurePercent"], i), level),
            })
        end
    end

    return list
end

local function ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end
    local effects = BuildEffectList(cfg, level, "Effect")
    local additional = BuildEffectList(cfg, level, "AdditionalEffect")
    if #effects == 0 and #additional == 0 then
        return
    end

    overrides.__effect_overrides = overrides.__effect_overrides or {
        replace = {},
        additional = {},
    }

    if #effects > 0 then
        for _, entry in ipairs(effects) do
            table.insert(overrides.__effect_overrides.replace, entry)
        end
    end
    if #additional > 0 then
        for _, entry in ipairs(additional) do
            table.insert(overrides.__effect_overrides.additional, entry)
        end
    end
end

local function GetEnhancePassiveKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhancePassiveKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance Passive"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance Passive"]
    end
    return kv
end

local function GetLocalizeVariablesSection(section)
    local kv = LocalizeVariablesKV or {}
    if not section or section == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return kv[section] or {}
end

local function ParseMappingToken(token)
    if type(token) ~= "string" then
        return nil, nil
    end
    if token == "" then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local prefix = "ability:"
    if string.sub(token, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return string.sub(token, #prefix + 1), "ability"
    end
    return token, "value"
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhanceKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"]
    end
    return kv
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildSourceIndex()
    self.source_index = {}
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV() or {}
    for name, cfg in pairs(kv) do
        local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local key = tostring(src)
            if key ~= "" then
                self.source_index[key] = self.source_index[key] or {}
                table.insert(self.source_index[key], name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)
    if not source_key or source_key == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return self.source_index[source_key] or {}
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return 1
    end
    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1
    if stacks == -1 then
        return -1
    end
    if stacks < 1 then
        stacks = 1
    end
    return stacks
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
    local id = tonumber(self.config and self.config.shop_item_id) or 2
    if id < 1 then
        id = 2
    end
    return id
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.GetCurrentPrice then
        return 0, nil
    end
    local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
    return mgr:GetCurrentPrice(id), mgr
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ConsumeEnhancePrice(pid)
    local price, mgr = self:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    if price <= 0 then
        return true, price, mgr
    end
    local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
    if gold < price then
        return false, price, mgr, gold
    end
    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
    if mgr and mgr.items then
        local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
        local cfg = mgr.items[id]
        if cfg then
            cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
        end
    end
    return true, price, mgr, gold
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:CanStartSelection(pid, opts)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return false, "invalid"
    end

    local force_unlocked = opts and opts.force_unlocked
    if not force_unlocked and not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return false, "locked"
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state then
        return false, "state"
    end

    if state.selection then
        return false, "busy"
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return false, "empty"
    end

    return true, "ok"
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return false
    end
    return tonumber(cfg.Open or 0) == 1
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources)
    if not item_sources or not cfg_sources then
        return false
    end
    for _, src in ipairs(cfg_sources) do
        local target = tostring(src)
        if target ~= "" then
            for _, item_src in ipairs(item_sources) do
                if tostring(item_src) == target then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    self:BuildSourceIndex()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end
    return state.purchased[name] or 0
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if stacks ~= -1 then
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        if purchased >= stacks then
            return false
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, source_key)
    local changed = false
    for _, name in ipairs(self:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do
        if state.pool_list[i] == name then
            table.remove(state.pool_list, i)
            break
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state then
        return {}
    end
    return state.pool_list
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsUnlocked(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return true
    end
    if not SpawnWallManager or not SpawnWallManager.GetExpansionProgress then
        return true
    end
    local _, _, count = SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    count = tonumber(count or 0) or 0
    return count >= 5
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    local pool_count = (state and state.pool_list and #state.pool_list) or 0
    return {
        unlocked = self:IsUnlocked(pid),
        available = pool_count > 0,
        pool_count = pool_count,
    }
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end

    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name]
    if not kv then
        return false
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local changed = false
    for _, src in ipairs(CollectItemSources(kv, lvl)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, src) or changed
    end

    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, lvl)
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false
    local applied_extra = {}

    for enhance_name, count in pairs(state.purchased or {}) do
        if count and count > 0 then
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
            if self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
                local cfg_sources = NormalizeList(cfg.Source)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources) then
                    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
                    local enhance_level = (stacks == -1) and count or math.min(count, stacks)
                    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, lvl)) do
                        ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, slot.context, slot.name, item_kv, lvl)
                    end
                    if not applied_extra[enhance_name] then
                        ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, item_kv, lvl)
                        ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, enhance_level)
                        applied_extra[enhance_name] = true
                    end
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides
end

local function BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level, enhance_name)
    local vars = {}
    if not cfg then
        return vars
    end

    local enhance_map = GetLocalizeVariablesSection("shop1_items_enhance.txt")
    local map_count = 0
    for _ in pairs(enhance_map) do
        map_count = map_count + 1
    end
    if map_count == 0 then
        print("[Shop1Enhance] localize map empty", tostring(enhance_name), tostring(LocalizeVariablesKV))
    else
        print("[Shop1Enhance] localize map size", tostring(enhance_name), map_count,
            "ProjectileInterval=>", tostring(enhance_map.ProjectileInterval))
    end
    for source_key, token in pairs(enhance_map) do
        if source_key ~= "__default__" then
            local mapped_key, mode = ParseMappingToken(token)
            if mapped_key then
                local raw = cfg[source_key]
                if raw ~= nil and raw ~= "" then
                    if mode == "ability" then
                        local name = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
                        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
                            vars[mapped_key] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(name)
                        end
                    else
                        local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayText(raw, level)
                        if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
                            vars[mapped_key] = val
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function merge_passive_vars(name)
        if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
            return
        end
        local kv = GetEnhancePassiveKV()
        local entry = kv and kv[name]
        if not entry then
            return
        end
        local passive_map = GetLocalizeVariablesSection("shop1_items_enhance_passive.txt")
        local default_mode = passive_map["__default__"]
        for k, v in pairs(entry) do
            local token = passive_map[k]
            if token == nil and default_mode == "*" then
                token = tostring(k)
            end
            local mapped_key, mode = ParseMappingToken(token)
            if mapped_key and vars[mapped_key] == nil then
                if mode == "ability" then
                    local name = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(v, level)
                    if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
                        vars[mapped_key] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(name)
                    end
                else
                    local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayText(v, level)
                    if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
                        vars[mapped_key] = val
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function merge_list(raw)
        local list = NormalizeList(raw)
        for _, name in ipairs(list) do
            merge_passive_vars(tostring(name))
        end
    end

    merge_list(cfg.Passive)
    merge_list(cfg.AbilitySP)
    merge_list(cfg.ModifierSP)
    merge_list(cfg.Item)

    return vars
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name) or {}
    local level = 1
    if pid then
        local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        level = purchased + 1
        if stacks ~= -1 then
            level = math.min(level, stacks)
        end
        if level < 1 then
            level = 1
        end
    end

    local display_name = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_name"
    local display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_desc"

    local payload = {
        ability = name or "",
        image = NormalizePanoramaImagePath(cfg.Image),
        display_name = display_name or "",
        display_desc = display_desc or "",
        display_desc_vars = BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level, name),
    }

    if payload.image == "" and name and name ~= "" then
        payload.image = "s2r://panorama/images/spellicons/" .. name .. "_png.vtex"
    end

    return payload
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(pid, opts)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local force_unlocked = opts and opts.force_unlocked
    if not force_unlocked and not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or state.selection then
        return
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return
    end

    local temp_pool = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(pool) do
        temp_pool[i] = name
    end

    local choices = {}
    local count = self.config.choice_count or 3
    local item_source = opts and opts.item_source

    local function GetWeightedValue(enhance_name)
        local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
        local weight = GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
        if item_source and ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, item_source) then
            weight = math.min(weight * 2, 1000)
        end
        return weight
    end

    if item_source and #temp_pool > 0 then
        local matching = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(temp_pool) do
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
            if ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, item_source) then
                table.insert(matching, name)
            end
        end
        if #matching > 0 then
            local name = PickWeighted(matching, GetWeightedValue)
            choices[1] = name
            for i = #temp_pool, 1, -1 do
                if temp_pool[i] == name then
                    table.remove(temp_pool, i)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, count do
        if choices[i] ~= nil then
            goto continue
        end
        if #temp_pool > 0 then
            local name, idx = PickWeighted(temp_pool, GetWeightedValue)
            choices[i] = name
            if idx then
                table.remove(temp_pool, idx)
            end
        else
            choices[i] = nil
        end
        ::continue::
    end

    state.selection = {
        choices = choices,
    }

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if player then
        local payload = {
            player_id = pid,
            choice_count = count,
            title = "#shop1_enhance_pick_title",
            choices = {},
        }

        for i = 1, count do
            local name = choices[i]
            if name and name ~= "" then
                payload.choices[i] = self:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
            else
                payload.choices[i] = {
                    ability = "",
                    image = "s2r://panorama/images/hero_selection/empty_hero_card_png.vtex",
                }
            end
        end

        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_show", payload)
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ClearSelection(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if state then
        state.selection = nil
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SendClose(pid)
    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end
    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_close", {
        player_id = pid,
    })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local price, mgr = self:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop1Enhance] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    local ok = self:CanStartSelection(pid)
    if not ok then
        return
    end

    if price > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
        if mgr and mgr.items then
            local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
            local cfg = mgr.items[id]
            if cfg then
                cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
            end
        end
        if mgr and mgr.SyncToClient then
            mgr:SyncToClient()
        end
    end

    self:StartSelection(pid, { force_unlocked = true })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    local idx = tonumber(event.choice_index or -1)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not state.selection then
        return
    end

    if idx < 1 then
        return
    end

    local choice = state.selection.choices and state.selection.choices[idx]
    if not choice or choice == "" then
        return
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(choice)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        self:ClearSelection(pid)
        return
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, choice) + 1
    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased > stacks then
        purchased = stacks
    end
    self:SetPurchasedCount(pid, choice, purchased)

    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased >= stacks then
        self:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, choice)
    end

    -- Unlock derived enhances chained by Source
    self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, choice)

    self:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)

    self:ClearSelection(pid)
    self:SendClose(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.RefreshItemsForEnhance then
        return
    end

    mgr:RefreshItemsForEnhance()

    if mgr.SyncToClient then
        mgr:SyncToClient()
    end
end

The spawn animation likely results from RefreshItemsForEnhance fully removing and re-adding items, triggering dummy recreation or visual reveal even when dummies are reused from the pool. This suggests options to fix include avoiding unnecessary dummy recreation by reusing existing ones or retaining NoDraw plus SetModel to prevent the visual spawn effect.

**Providing detailed analysis and fix options in Chinese**

RefreshItemsForEnhance在刷新时会移除并重新添加所有物品，导致每个物品的假人单位（dummy）重新创建，从而触发“spawn”动画。具体流程是：Shop1EnhanceManager通过OnEnhanceChoice调用ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer，再调用RefreshItemsForEnhance，每次都会完全重建物品。建议优化方案有：只刷新受影响的物品，避免无关物品也被移除重建；或者修改modifier_item_autocast_controller，让其更新覆盖效果而不是删除重建假人；如果只是想隐藏动画，可以在假人显示后调用`dummy:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_SPAWN)`来去掉生成动作。由于刷新导致所有物品被重新添加，所以每个物品都播放了生成动画。

payload.message:
原因基本就在“强化选择后会刷新全部物品”，导致所有 dummy 被重新创建/重新显示，从而触发出生动画。

具体链路（你项目里的代码）：
- `Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceChoice` 里调用 `ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer`
- `ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer` 里调用 `Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance`
- `RefreshItemsForEnhance` 会把当前所有 slot 的物品先 `RemoveItem`，再 `AddItem` 重建
- 这会重新走 `modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy` / `UpdateFormationAtPos` / `RevealAllVisuals`，所以每个 dummy 又“第一次显示”一次，播放出生动画

定位到的根因：**刷新策略是全量重建**，不是只更新命中强化的那些物品。

可能的解决方向（从根本到快速抑制）：
1) 精确刷新：只重建“受本次强化影响”的物品（按 Source 匹配），避免所有 item 都重建。
2) 仅更新覆盖：在 `modifier_item_autocast_controller` 里加“重新读取 override”的入口，不销毁/重建 dummy。
3) 视觉抑制：在 dummy `RemoveNoDraw` 之后强制移除出生动画（`RemoveGesture`/`FadeGesture`），只抑制视觉，但不会解决重建带来的性能/逻辑刷新。

如果你想做哪一条，我可以直接改：  
- 如果要“精确刷新”，我需要你确认：强化选择后只刷新 **匹配 Source 的 item** 是否符合预期。  
- 如果要“抑制出生动画”，我可以在 `RevealAllVisuals` 里加手势清理。

    local career = NormalizeCareer(profile.career)

    local is_boss = IsBossUnit(enemy) and 1 or 0
    if not cfg then
        return 0, dist, is_boss

    local bonus = 0
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "warrior" then

        local pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if range > 0 and dist <= range then

    elseif career_key == "ranged" then

    if not self.tooltips then return 0 end

        return self.tooltips[params.ability_special_value]
    end

    return 0
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        self:InitStat()
    end)
end

function modifier_item_stats:InitStat()
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Server", self)
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then return end

    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if pid < 0 then return end

    local lvl = ability.custom_level or self.custom_level or 1
    self.level = lvl
    local name = ability.raw_name
    local raw_kv = ItemKV[name] or AbilityKV[name]
    local type = 1
    if raw_kv and raw_kv.Shop then
        type = tonumber(raw_kv.Shop)
    end

    local kv = {}
    if type == 1 then
        kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 2 then
        kv = Shop2ItemsKV[name] or {}
    elseif type == 3 then
        kv = Shop3ItemsKV[name] or {}
    end

    self.kv = kv

    self:CollectValues()
    self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()

    ability:SetLevel(self.level)
    self:ForceRefresh()

    local attrs = {}

    if kv.BonusAttribute then
        for k, v in pairs(kv.BonusAttribute) do
            local value_array = ParseArray(v)
            local attr_value = value_array[lvl]
            if attr_value ~= nil then
                attrs[k] = attr_value
            end
        end
    end

    if next(attrs) ~= nil then
        StatsManager:AddSource(pid, self:GetSourceId(), attrs, {
            type = "equip",
            item = name,
            level = lvl,
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:CollectValues()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    local ab = self:GetAbility()

    local kv = ab:GetAbilityKeyValues()
    local sp = kv.AbilityValues

    if not sp then return end

    self.tooltips = {}
    self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys = {}
    for k, v in pairs(sp) do
        if k == "Level" then
            self.tooltips[k] = self.level
        else
            local kv_value = ab:GetSpecialValueFor(k)

            local array = self.kv[k] or self.kv.BonusAttribute[k]

            if self.kv.BonusAttribute[k] then
                table.insert(self.tooltips.BonusAttributeKeys, k)
            end

            local value = 0
            if array then
                value = ParseArray(array)[self.level] or 0
            end
            self.tooltips[k] = value

            --print("[modifier_item_stats] tooltip", k, value, self.level)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()

    if pid >= 0 then
        StatsManager:RemoveSource(pid, self:GetSourceId())
    end
end

function modifier_item_stats:GetSourceId()
    if self:GetAbility() == nil then
        return
    end

    return "equip_" .. self:GetAbility():GetAbilityName() .. "_" .. tostring(self)
end

function modifier_item_stats:AddCustomTransmitterData()
    return {
        tooltips = self.tooltips or {}
    }
end

function modifier_item_stats:HandleCustomTransmitterData(data)
    --print("[modifier_item_stats] Client", self)
    self.tooltips = data.tooltips or {}

    --DeepPrintTable(self.tooltips)
end

FilterEnemiesByAngle = function(profile, enemies, origin)
    local limit = profile and profile.search_angle_limit_deg or nil
    if not limit or not origin or not GoodForward then
        return enemies
    end
    local filtered = {}
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do

            if angle and angle <= limit then
                table.insert(filtered, enemy)
            end
        end
    end
    return filtered
end

+        projectile_sp_2_range        = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
+        projectile_sp_2_base_damage  = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,

+
+        passive_sp                   = self.passive_sp,
+        passive_sp_level             = self.passive_sp_level,
+
+        passive_sp_2                 = self.passive_sp_2,
+        passive_sp_2_level           = self.passive_sp_2_level,
+
+        ability_sp                   = self.ability_sp,

+        career                       = self.career,
+    }
+end
+
+function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RefreshAfterEnhance()
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+
+    local parent = self:GetParent()
+    local ability = self:GetAbility()
+    if not parent or parent:IsNull() or not ability then
+        return
+    end
+

+        return
+    end
+

+
+    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    self.dummy.__autocast_additional_projectiles = self.extra_projectiles
+    self.dummy.__autocast_additional_passives = self.additional_passives
+    self.dummy.__autocast_effects = self.effects
+    self.dummy.__autocast_additional_effects = self.additional_effects

一、核心概念与目标
- 强化是按玩家累计的增益选择系统，用于对 Shop1 物品的弹幕与被动进行可控覆盖与扩展。
- 强化只作用于匹配 Source 的物品，不直接改动非匹配物品。
- 强化等级 = 已购买次数（受 `Stacks` 限制），用于挑选列表值并计算数值覆盖。

   - 强化卡片、可用性、权重、适用 Source、数值覆盖、追加弹幕/被动/效果等。

   - 被动能力参数仓库（供被动脚本读取与本地化变量提取）。

三、Source 规则（设计约定）
- 物品 Source 来自 Shop1 物品 KV：`ProjectileName`、`ProjectileSP*`、`PassiveName`、`PassiveSP*`、
  `AbilitySP`、`ModifierSP`。
- `attack`/`ranged_attack` 会被拼上 `HeroName` 前缀（例：`drow_ranger_ranged_attack`），强化 `Source`
  必须与此一致。
- 购买强化后会执行 `AddEnhancesBySource(pid, choice)`，因此 `Source` 可指向“强化名称”形成链式解锁。

四、强化选择流程
- 物品获得时（`Shop1Manager:AddItem`）根据物品 Source 把匹配强化加入玩家池。
- 物品升到 4 级时会自动触发一次选择（`StartSelection`，携带 `item_source`）。
- 也可通过事件 `shop1_enhance_request` 触发（先扣费）。
- 选择池为空、已在选择中、或未解锁（`SpawnWallManager` 进度 < 5）都会阻止选择，`force_unlocked` 可跳过。
- 权重规则：
  - `Weight` 裁剪到 [0, 1000]；总权重为 0 时随机挑。
  - 传入 `item_source` 时，优先从 `ItemSource` 匹配项里抽第一个选项，并将其权重 *2（上限 1000）。
- 选择结果表现：完成选择并刷新后，适用物品会播放 `legion_commander_press_the_attack` 特效（2/3 阶取 selection proxy 的中心点）。

五、shop1_items_enhance.txt 字段（核心）
- 通用：
  - `Open`: 1 表示可用；0 直接忽略。
  - `Stacks`: 最大叠加次数；`-1` 表示无限。
  - `Weight`: 抽取权重。
  - `Image`: UI 图片，自动规范为 s2r 路径；为空时回退到 `spellicons/<name>`.
  - `Source`: 解锁来源（`|` 分隔列表）。
  - `ItemSource`: 选择时的物品来源匹配（`|` 分隔列表）。
- Source 弹幕覆盖（按 Projectile 上下文匹配）：
  - `Projectile`: 目标弹幕名列表；为空视为 index=1。
  - `ProjectileInterval` / `ProjectileRange` / `ProjectileBaseDamage` / `ProjectileDamageScale`
  - `HealPercent` / `PurePercent`
- 新增弹幕（追加到 `ProjectileSP3+`）：
  - `AdditionalProjectile`
  - `AdditionalProjectileLevel`
  - `AdditionalProjectileInterval` / `AdditionalProjectileRange`
  - `AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage` / `AdditionalProjectileDamageScale`
  - `AdditionalPurePercent`
- 新增被动与其他插槽：
  - `Passive` / `PassiveLevel`（按顺序塞入第一个空的 `PassiveSP1..6`）
  - `AbilitySP` / `ModifierSP` / `LifestealSP`（单项覆盖）
- 效果覆盖（Effect 列表）：
  - `EffectName` / `EffectInterval` / `EffectRange`
  - `EffectBaseDamage` / `EffectDamageScale` / `EffectHealPercent` / `EffectPurePercent`
  - `AdditionalEffect*` 作为追加列表；`Effect*` 为替换列表。

六、覆盖与取值规则（关键逻辑）
- 强化等级用于挑选列表值（`"1 2 3"` 或 `"1|2|3"`）。
- 数值覆盖：
  - 百分号字符串（如 `50%`）按 `base * (1 + percent/100)` 计算。
  - 纯数字按 `base + value` 计算。
  - `0`/`"0"` 不写入 override。
  - base 值来自原始物品 KV（含已被前序强化改写的值）。
- 影响范围：
  - 仅对匹配 Source 的物品生效。
  - `Projectile` 列表用于匹配每个 slot 的弹幕名；命中的 index 决定使用哪一组数值。
- 追加规则（设计约定）：
  - `AdditionalProjectile` 总是从 `ProjectileSP3` 起向后追加，`ProjectileSP1/2` 保留给基础物品配置。
  - `Passive` 追加到首个空位；若 6 个槽已满，回退写入 `PassiveSP3`（会覆盖）。
- Effect 覆盖：
  - `Effect*` 会替换原有效果列表，`AdditionalEffect*` 会追加到列表末尾。

七、被动参数语义（来自 shop1_items_enhance_passive.txt）
- 仅作“参数仓库”，由被动能力脚本自行读取。
- 约定字段（同功能同字段）：
  - `count`：次数/数量
  - `max_distance`：最大距离
  - `search_range`：搜索范围
  - `speed`：速度
  - `radius`：半径
  - `start_offset`：起点偏移
  - `damage_mult`：源攻击附加倍率
  - `damage_bonus`：额外伤害加成
  - `base_damage` / `damage_scale`：衍生弹幕自身伤害
  - `hits_target`：是否命中原目标

八、伤害缩放与约定
- Shop1 弹幕统一走 Projectile 伤害通道（见 autocast/filters）。
- Source 弹幕用 `ProjectileBaseDamage/ProjectileDamageScale`；衍生弹幕用自身 `base_damage/damage_scale`。
- 强化仅改写数值与插槽，不改变伤害系统计算规则。

payload.text:
**Analyzing proxy unit selection and targeting**

The proxy is made visible/selectable despite being no-draw, serving only as a selection redirect to the real dummy unit. Although it lacks healthbar and collision and is invulnerable, spells require real units as targets, so ability targeting likely filters proxy casts. The selection system maps proxy selections back to the dummy, implying any direct casts on the proxy are intercepted or ignored, ensuring purification or similar abilities only affect the intended real unit.

**Clarifying proxy dummy untargetability and selection handling**

The proxy dummy is invulnerable, hidden with AddNoDraw, lacks abilities, and is set unselectable for spells, so it can’t be directly targeted by abilities like Purification. Selection.lua remaps selections from proxy back to the real dummy, ensuring casts apply to the true unit. The proxy exists solely for selection visuals and position reference, while actual targeting and casting must use the main dummy unit.

payload.message:
根据 `modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy` 的实现，proxy dummy 只是“编队选择代理”，不是一个真正可施放目标的单位，关键点有这些（直接来自代码逻辑）：

- 代理在创建时就 `proxy:AddNoDraw()`，模型不可见，不会被命中检测/鼠标点中，所以实际无法作为施法目标。位置在 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua:509`。
- 代理被加了 `modifier_invulnerable`、`modifier_no_healthbar`、`modifier_phased`、`modifier_rooted`，即使能被点中，很多技能默认也不会以“无敌单位”为合法目标（目标过滤）——见 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua:498` 至 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua:507`。
- 代理只是用来“选择映射”，selection 系统会把选中代理映射回主 dummy（`dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy`），所以施法逻辑层最终指向主 dummy，而不是 proxy（见 selection 系统逻辑）。  

结论：proxy dummy 不是可施放目标，设计上仅用于“编队中心 + 选择”，不能作为洗礼（Purification）之类的“目标单位”。  
如果你想要视觉中心在编队中心，同时不改变施法目标，可以继续用 proxy 的位置播放特效（已经在逻辑里做了），但不要让技能实际“施放到 proxy”。

如果你需要“可施放目标”的代理单位，需要把它变成可见、可被选、可被施法的单位（至少去掉 `AddNoDraw` 和 invulnerable），但这会影响选择/拖拽逻辑和表现。

    end

function EndCustomGame(result)
    -- print("[End]", GameState.game_over_flag, GameState.game_start)

    if GameState.game_over_flag then return end
    GameState.game_over_flag = true

    GameState.game_start = false

    print("[Game] EndCustomGame =>", result)

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        ClearAllGroundItems()
        ResetAllHeroes()

        for pid, mgr in pairs(SpawnManagers) do
            if mgr.StopAll then
                mgr:StopAll()
            end
        end

        PlayerStats:Clear()
        StatsManager:Clear()
        PlayerResourceExt:Clear()

        })
    end)

function ClearAllGroundItems()
    local drops = Entities:FindAllByClassname("dota_item_drop")

    for _, drop in pairs(drops) do
        if not drop:IsNull() then
            local item = drop:GetContainedItem()
            if item and not item:IsNull() then
                item:RemoveSelf()
            end
            drop:RemoveSelf()
        end
    end
end

function ResetAllHeroes()
    local heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes()
    if not heroes then
        return
    end

    local assigned = {}
    local assigned_count = 0
    for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
        if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
            if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                local entid = assigned_hero:entindex()
                if not assigned[entid] then
                    assigned[entid] = true
                    assigned_count = assigned_count + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- print("heros", assigned_count)

    for _, hero in ipairs(heroes) do
        if hero:IsRealHero() and not hero:IsTempestDouble() and not hero:IsClone() then
            local pid = hero:GetPlayerID()
            local heroName = hero:GetUnitName()

            -- print("[Shop1Managers]", pid, Shop1Managers, Shop1Managers[pid], hero, hero:GetUnitName())
            Shop1Managers[pid]:DestroyAllItems(hero)

            for i = 0, hero:GetAbilityCount() - 1 do
                local ability = hero:GetAbilityByIndex(i)
                if ability then
                    hero:RemoveAbilityByHandle(ability)
                end
            end

            local modifiers = hero:FindAllModifiers()
            for _, mod in pairs(modifiers) do
                mod:Destroy()
            end

            hero:Stop()

            -- 2. 关闭自动攻击
            hero:SetIdleAcquire(false)
            hero:SetAcquisitionRange(0)

            -- 3. 清空当前攻击目标
            hero:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)

            -- 4. 直接 Kill（非常重要）
            hero:ForceKill(false)

            local newHero = PlayerResource:ReplaceHeroWith(pid, heroName, 0, 0)

            Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
                if newHero and not newHero:IsNull() then
                    local spawn = PlayerSpawnPoint[pid]
                    if spawn then
                        local pos = spawn:GetOrigin()
                        FindClearSpaceForUnit(newHero, pos, true)
                        -- print("Respawn", pos)
                        newHero:SetOrigin(pos)
                    end

                    newHero:Stop()
                    if SpawnWallManager and SpawnWallManager.ResetPlayer then
                        SpawnWallManager:ResetPlayer(pid, newHero)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        local keep = {}
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
            if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
                local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
                local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
                if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                    keep[assigned_hero:entindex()] = true
                end
            end
        end

        local all_heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes() or {}
        for _, unit in ipairs(all_heroes) do
            if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:IsRealHero()
                and not unit:IsTempestDouble() and not unit:IsClone() and not unit:IsSpiritBearCustom()
                and not keep[unit:entindex()] then
                if UTIL_Remove then
                    UTIL_Remove(unit)
                else
                    unit:RemoveSelf()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

    if PlayerSpawnPoint[pid] then

    end

    local team = PlayerResource:GetTeam(pid)
    local name = team == DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS

    local spawns = Entities:FindAllByClassname(name)

**Analyzing proxy rendering and targetability**

The selection proxy currently uses a hidden thinker unit with NoDraw but is set selectable; wanting to keep its behavior but make it targetable and visibly rendered likely means removing NoDraw while preserving other logic. Next, I'll explore making the proxy a visible creature unit without breaking its existing selection and functionality.

**Detailing fx provider manager and proxy targetability**

The proxy dummy must keep its current behavior but be targetable and visibly renderable for skill effects—this likely means removing invulnerable and NoDraw modifiers while keeping it selectable and immune to unwanted interactions. The fx_provider_manager will manage a pool of offscreen dummy units with overridden cast range modifiers, casting original or custom abilities on targets per KV behavior, handling ally/enemy team assignment to satisfy targeting rules and enabling simultaneous casts. Next steps include implementing the manager with provider pooling, large cast range override modifier, and ability casting logic respecting ability behavior and teams.

**Planning provider cast range and behavior parsing**

I'm defining a cast range modifier to grant providers effectively unlimited cast range and planning provider pooling with busy flags for multiple simultaneous casts. I'll parse ability behavior from KV—likely reusing existing utilities—to decide cast order type (target, position, no target) per the requirement to cast appropriately based on ability settings.

    if not ability_kv then

        if #nums > 0 then
            local idx = math.max(level or 1, 1)
            idx = math.min(idx, #nums)
            return tonumber(nums[idx]) or 0
        end
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.ParseAbilityDuration(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local dur = ability_kv.AbilityDuration
    if type(dur) == "number" then
        return dur
    end
    if type(dur) == "string" and dur ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(dur, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return 0
    end
    local ability = profile.skill
    local level = 1
    if ability.GetLevel then
        level = math.max(ability:GetLevel(), 1)
    end
    return M.ParseAbilityCastRange(profile.skill_kv or ability:GetAbilityKeyValues(), level)
end

function M.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, use_direct_cast)
    if not parent or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
    local behavior = ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "TOGGLE") then
        ability:ToggleAbility()
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "AUTOCAST") then
        if not ability:GetAutoCastState() then
            ability:ToggleAutoCast()
        end
        return
    end

    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit.__tiny_grab_busy then
        return true
    end

    local function IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive()
        if not unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility or not unit.HasModifier then
            return false
        end

        local ability = unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility()
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "crystal_maiden_freezing_field" then
            return false
        end

        -- Aghanim allows full action during channel
        return unit:HasModifier("modifier_item_ultimate_scepter")
    end

    -- Channeling normally blocks everything
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        if not IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive() then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- CastPoint (ability windup) always blocks
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        return true
    end

    -- AttackPoint (attack windup) blocks
    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        if unit.IsPerformingAttack and unit:IsPerformingAttack() then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end


function M.GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default_stats
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default_stats
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default_stats
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

function M.NormalizeName(value)
    if value and value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

function M.ToNumber(value)
    if value == nil or value == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(value)
end

return M

payload.text:
**Designing proxy modifier to block damage but allow targeting**

Planning to create a new modifier that sets incoming damage to zero while keeping the unit targetable and selectable, using states like no health bar and no minimap presence. Keeping the proxy invisible via AddNoDraw is acceptable since selection happens programmatically, ensuring abilities can still target it despite no visual presence.

**Planning comprehensive fx provider manager with selection proxy updates**

Outlining a new fx provider manager to spawn offscreen dummy units that cast original abilities (like purification and press the attack) to reproduce exact synth/enhance effects, managing ability targeting, team alignment, casting behavior, cooldowns, and pooling. Also finalizing removal of invulnerable on selection proxy in favor of a custom modifier that prevents damage but keeps targetability, no health bar, and proper visibility states to satisfy fx and selection requirements. Next steps include implementing the manager, modifiers, hooking into existing managers, and updating docs accordingly.

**Finalizing proxy modifier and fx provider integration**

Planning to implement the new proxy target modifier preventing damage but allowing attacks and spells while keeping selection proxy no healthbar and phased/rooted, retaining AddNoDraw for invisibility. Preparing to replace existing manual particle calls with fx provider manager ability casts in synthesis and enhancement flows and updating docs accordingly.

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/fx_provider_manager.lua
+if FxProviderManager == nil then
+    FxProviderManager = class({})
+end
+
+LinkLuaModifier("modifier_fx_provider_range",
+    "modifiers/modifier_fx_provider_range.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)
+
+local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
+
+FxProviderManager.pools = FxProviderManager.pools or {}
+FxProviderManager.busy = FxProviderManager.busy or {}
+
+local PROVIDER_UNIT_NAME = "npc_dota_fx_provider"
+local OFFSCREEN_POS = Vector(10000, 10000, 0)
+
+local function HasFlag(raw, flag)
+    return raw and string.find(raw, flag, 1, true)
+end
+
+local function ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
+    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
+    if HasFlag(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
+        return "Position"
+    end
+    if HasFlag(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
+        return "Target"
+    end
+    if HasFlag(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
+        return "NoTarget"
+    end
+    return "NoTarget"
+end
+
+local function ResolveCasterTeam(ability_kv, target)
+    local target_team = target and target.GetTeamNumber and target:GetTeamNumber() or DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
+    local team_rule = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
+    local friendly = HasFlag(team_rule, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY")
+    local enemy = HasFlag(team_rule, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY")
+
+    if enemy and not friendly then
+        if target_team == DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS then
+            return DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS
+        end
+        if target_team == DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS then
+            return DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
+        end
+        return DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS
+    end
+
+    return target_team
+end
+
+local function ParseNumber(raw)
+    if raw == nil then
+        return 0
+    end
+    if type(raw) == "number" then
+        return raw
+    end
+    local s = tostring(raw)
+    local first = string.match(s, "[-%d%.]+")
+    return tonumber(first) or 0
+end
+
+local function ParseCastPoint(ability_kv)
+    return ParseNumber(ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityCastPoint or 0)
+end
+
+local function ParseChannelTime(ability_kv)
+    return ParseNumber(ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityChannelTime or 0)
+end
+
+function FxProviderManager:AcquireProvider(team)
+    team = team or DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
+    self.pools[team] = self.pools[team] or {}
+
+    for i = #self.pools[team], 1, -1 do
+        local unit = self.pools[team][i]
+        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
+            table.remove(self.pools[team], i)
+        end
+    end
+
+    for _, unit in ipairs(self.pools[team]) do
+        if unit and not unit:IsNull() and not self.busy[unit] then
+            return unit
+        end
+    end
+
+    local unit = CreateUnitByName(
+        PROVIDER_UNIT_NAME,
+        OFFSCREEN_POS,
+        false,
+        nil,
+        nil,
+        team
+    )
+    if not unit then
+        return nil
+    end
+
+    unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_fx_provider_range", {})
+    table.insert(self.pools[team], unit)
+    return unit
+end
+
+function FxProviderManager:ReleaseProvider(unit, delay)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
+        return
+    end
+    local wait = tonumber(delay) or 0
+    if wait <= 0 then
+        self.busy[unit] = nil
+        unit:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
+        return
+    end
+    self.busy[unit] = true
+    Timers:CreateTimer(wait, function()
+        if unit and not unit:IsNull() then
+            self.busy[unit] = nil
+            unit:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
+        end
+        return nil
+    end)
+end
+
+function FxProviderManager:EnsureAbility(unit, ability_name, level)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() or not ability_name or ability_name == "" then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local ability = unit:FindAbilityByName(ability_name)
+    if not ability then
+        ability = unit:AddAbility(ability_name)
+    end
+    if not ability then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local lvl = tonumber(level) or 1
+    if ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() < lvl then
+        ability:SetLevel(lvl)
+    elseif ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() < 1 then
+        ability:SetLevel(1)
+    end
+    if ability.EndCooldown then
+        ability:EndCooldown()
+    end
+    return ability
+end
+
+function FxProviderManager:CastAbilityOnTarget(ability_name, target, opts)
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    if not target or target:IsNull() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local ability_kv = AbilityKV and AbilityKV[ability_name] or nil
+    local behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
+    local team = ResolveCasterTeam(ability_kv, target)
+
+    local provider = self:AcquireProvider(team)
+    if not provider then
+        return

    if not target or target:IsNull() then

    local ability_kv = AbilityKV and AbilityKV[ability_name] or nil
    local behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local team = ResolveCasterTeam(ability_kv, target)

    local provider = self:AcquireProvider(team)
    if not provider then

    end

    provider:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
    if provider.GetMaxMana and provider.SetMana then
        provider:SetMana(provider:GetMaxMana())
    end
    local ability = self:EnsureAbility(provider, ability_name, opts and opts.level)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if behavior == "Target" then
        print( "FxProviderManager: Casting ability ", ability_name, " on target ", target:GetUnitName(), target:entindex() )
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = provider:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
            Queue = false,

    elseif behavior == "Position" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = provider:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
            Queue = false,

    else
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = provider:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end

    local delay = ParseCastPoint(ability_kv) + ParseChannelTime(ability_kv)
    if delay <= 0 then
        delay = 0.2
    end
    self:ReleaseProvider(provider, delay)
end

if FxProviderManager == nil then
    FxProviderManager = class({})
end

FxProviderManager.pools = FxProviderManager.pools or {}
FxProviderManager.busy = FxProviderManager.busy or {}

local PROVIDER_UNIT_NAME = "npc_dota_fx_provider"
local OFFSCREEN_POS = Vector(0, -500, 128) -- Vector(10000, 10000, 128)

local function HasFlag(raw, flag)
    return raw and string.find(raw, flag, 1, true)
end

local function ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if HasFlag(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end
    if HasFlag(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        return "Target"
    end
    if HasFlag(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end
    return "NoTarget"
end

local function ResolveCasterTeam(ability_kv, target)
    local target_team = target and target.GetTeamNumber and target:GetTeamNumber() or DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    local team_rule = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
    local friendly = HasFlag(team_rule, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY")
    local enemy = HasFlag(team_rule, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY")

    if enemy and not friendly then
        if target_team == DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS then
            return DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS
        end
        if target_team == DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS then
            return DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
        end
        return DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS
    end

    return target_team
end

local function ParseNumber(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    local first = string.match(s, "[-%d%.]+")
    return tonumber(first) or 0
end

local function ParseCastPoint(ability_kv)
    return ParseNumber(ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityCastPoint or 0)
end

local function ParseChannelTime(ability_kv)
    return ParseNumber(ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityChannelTime or 0)
end

function FxProviderManager:AcquireProvider(team)
    team = team or DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    self.pools[team] = self.pools[team] or {}

    for i = #self.pools[team], 1, -1 do
        local unit = self.pools[team][i]
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            table.remove(self.pools[team], i)
        end
    end

    for _, unit in ipairs(self.pools[team]) do
        if unit and not unit:IsNull() and not self.busy[unit] then
            return unit
        end
    end

    local unit = CreateUnitByName(
        PROVIDER_UNIT_NAME,
        OFFSCREEN_POS,
        false,
        nil,
        nil,
        team
    )
    if not unit then
        return nil
    end

    unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_fx_provider_range", {})
    if unit.AddNoDraw then
        unit:AddNoDraw()
    end
    if unit.GetMaxMana and unit.SetMana then
        unit:SetMana(unit:GetMaxMana())
    end
    table.insert(self.pools[team], unit)
    return unit
end

function FxProviderManager:ReleaseProvider(unit, delay)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local wait = tonumber(delay) or 0
    if wait <= 0 then
        self.busy[unit] = nil
        unit:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
        return
    end
    self.busy[unit] = true
    Timers:CreateTimer(wait, function()
        if unit and not unit:IsNull() then
            self.busy[unit] = nil
            unit:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
        end
        return nil
    end)
end

function FxProviderManager:EnsureAbility(unit, ability_name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() or not ability_name or ability_name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local ability = unit:FindAbilityByName(ability_name)
    if not ability then
        ability = unit:AddAbility(ability_name)
    end
    if not ability then
        return nil
    end
    local lvl = tonumber(level) or 1
    if ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() < lvl then
        ability:SetLevel(lvl)
    elseif ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() < 1 then
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end
    if ability.EndCooldown then
        ability:EndCooldown()
    end
    return ability
end

function FxProviderManager:CastAbilityOnTarget(ability_name, target, opts)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = AbilityKV and AbilityKV[ability_name] or nil
    local behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local team = ResolveCasterTeam(ability_kv, target)

    local provider = self:AcquireProvider(team)
    if not provider then
        return
    end

    local owner = target.GetOwner and target:GetOwner() or nil
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        provider:SetOwner(owner)
        if owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
            provider:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
        end
    end

    provider:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
    if provider.GetMaxMana and provider.SetMana then
        provider:SetMana(provider:GetMaxMana())
    end
    local ability = self:EnsureAbility(provider, ability_name, opts and opts.level)
    if not ability then
        return
    end
    if ability.EndCooldown then
        ability:EndCooldown()
    end

    if AddFOWViewer and target.GetAbsOrigin then
        AddFOWViewer(team, target:GetAbsOrigin(), 600, 0.5, false)
    end

    if behavior == "Target" then
        print("FxProviderManager: Casting ability ", ability_name, " on target ", target:GetUnitName(), target:entindex())
        local moved = false
        if ability.CastFilterResultTarget then
            local result = ability:CastFilterResultTarget(target)
            if result ~= UF_SUCCESS then
                print("FxProviderManager: CastFilterResultTarget failed", tostring(result), "retry near target")
                provider:SetAbsOrigin(target:GetAbsOrigin())
                moved = true
                result = ability:CastFilterResultTarget(target)
                if result ~= UF_SUCCESS then
                    print("FxProviderManager: CastFilterResultTarget still failed", tostring(result))
                end
            end
        end
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = provider:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        if moved then
            provider:SetAbsOrigin(OFFSCREEN_POS)
        end
    elseif behavior == "Position" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = provider:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    else
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = provider:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end

    local delay = ParseCastPoint(ability_kv) + ParseChannelTime(ability_kv)
    if delay <= 0 then
        delay = 0.2
    end
    self:ReleaseProvider(provider, delay)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.RefreshItemsForEnhance then
        return
    end

    mgr:RefreshItemsForEnhance()

    if mgr.SyncToClient then
        mgr:SyncToClient()
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:PlayEnhanceChoiceFx(pid, enhance_name)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.Slots then
        return
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return
    end

    local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
    if #sources == 0 then
        return
    end

    for _, data in pairs(mgr.Slots) do
        if type(data) == "table" then
            local raw_name = mgr.GetRawNameFromData and mgr:GetRawNameFromData(data) or nil
            local level = mgr.GetDataLevel and mgr:GetDataLevel(data) or nil
            local item_kv = raw_name and (Shop1ItemsKV and (Shop1ItemsKV[raw_name] or (Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"] and Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"][raw_name]))) or nil
            if item_kv and level then
                local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, tonumber(level) or 1)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, sources) then
                    local fx_entity = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.selection_proxy
                    if not fx_entity or fx_entity:IsNull() then
                        local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
                        fx_entity = dummy
                    end
                    if fx_entity and not fx_entity:IsNull() then
                        table.insert(targets, fx_entity)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if #targets > 0 and FxProviderManager and FxProviderManager.CastAbilityOnTargets then
        FxProviderManager:CastAbilityOnTargets("legion_commander_press_the_attack", targets, { level = 1 })
    end
end
